newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING- Best Software to offer shares.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING- Best Software to offer shares.

text.p: Best Software Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an initial public offering of up to 3.65 million common shares, it expects to sell between $11 and $13 each.
The Reston, Va. computer software company said it will sell 2.75 million shares and a group of shareholders will offer 900,000 shares.
Underwriters for the offering, Hambrecht & Quist and William Blair & Co., have an over-allotment option of up to 547,500 shares.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate needs the company said.
After the offering, the company will have 10,865,722 shares outstanding.

For the year ended March 31, the company reported net income of $4.4 million, on revenue of $39.5 million. That compares to net income of $3.5 million, on revenue of $39.2 million, the year earlier, according to the SEC filing..
